turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Do not talk of ugliness, O-lan, for you are not ugly to me, and I will not have you speak so. We will get through this, together, and your son will marry and have sons of his own.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: But I have not finished making preparations for the feast, and I fear I will not live to see it. The food, the decorations, the music - it is all still to be done.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: You must not think of these things now, O-lan, we will finish the preparations together, I will help the maid and our son will assist us, we will get everything done.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: And what of the silk for the bride's dress? It must be ordered and paid for, but I fear I will not be here to see it made.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will order the silk, Mother, as soon as the preparations for the feast are underway. I have been taught how to choose the finest silk, and I will see that it is made into a beautiful dress for the bride.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, do not worry about the preparations for the feast, we will take care of everything. I will help Father and the maid, and we will make sure that everything is done just as you want it.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: You must not exhaust yourself with thoughts of the feast, my love. Think only of getting well, and we will take care of everything.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: But it is not just the feast, Wang Lung, I have seen the look in my son's eyes, he is thinking of taking a new wife, and I must see that she is worthy of our family's honor.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, do not worry about me taking a new wife, I will not do anything that would bring shame to our family. I promise to wait until you are well again and can give me your blessing.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will not bring shame to our family's honor, Mother. I will be patient and wait for your blessing, as is proper.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: You must listen to your son, O-lan, and not worry about the future. He is a good boy and will make a worthy husband.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I have seen the way the young women of the village look at him, with desire and admiration. You must choose wisely, Wang Lung.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will be careful, Mother, and choose a wife who is virtuous and kind, just like you.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I know you will choose wisely, Wang Lung, but I must also think of the future. The maid has been a good help to us, but she is young and not yet married. Perhaps... perhaps we can find a husband for her too.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I am content to wait for your decision, Father, and I am sure that you will choose a wife for me who is suitable for our family.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: You must not worry about the maid, O-lan. She is young and still learning, and we will find a good husband for her in time.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Do not trouble yourself with such worries, Mother. I will be content with whatever decision Father makes, and I am sure it will be for the best.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: But, my son, it is not just a matter of finding a husband for the maid. We must think of her future, and the future of our family, after I am gone.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I know, Mother, but you must not worry about us. Father will take care of everything, and we will be fine.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, do not speak of such things. Your health is all that matters to me, and I will not have you worrying about the future of our family.
